hook.text: 'Bank' can mean a river bank or a financial bank—same word, two related origins.

buildup.text: Polysemy is when one word has multiple related meanings that branched from a common source.

discovery.text: 'Head' means body part, leader, top of a nail, and head of a table—all extended from one core.

twist.text: Polysemy differs from homonymy: 'bank' (river) and 'bank' (money) actually have separate origins.

climax.text: Most common English words are polysemous—the ten most frequent verbs average over 20 senses each.

punchline.text: The more common a word, the more meanings it carries.

quiz.question: What is polysemy?
options: One word with multiple related meanings
